content: Beauty is truth, truth beauty, - that is all ye know on earth, and all ye need to know.
author: John Keats
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

John Keats understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
